follow-up time: until the third to seventh days after the second menstruation and pregnancies occurring during the observation period were recorded
exposure: Three groups based on treatment received after transcervical hysteroscopic resection of uterine septum (TCRS): IUD placement (group A), ERT (group B), and neither (group C)
finding: There were no significant differences in uterine adhesion, pregnancy rate, abortion frequency, live birth rate, and cesarean section rate among the three groups, while the postoperational cost of group C (no IUD or ERT) was significantly lower.
